title: docs: cite landing commits where pending changesets and source comments name fourteen objectui issues that answer 404 (objectui#10803)
body:
Part of #10803
Clause-②: no

Dispatched implementation of the `domain:ui` seat #1 claim (comment `5859894652`) on objectui#10803, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01DuWo5bdP9SdVebamn99GGk`. Citations only: no sentence's claim moves and every edited pending changeset's frontmatter is byte-identical. The only code tokens that move are eleven zod `.describe()` strings in `@object-ui/types`, each losing its dead pointer (patch round, under the seat's claim amendment `5860244997`).

## Why `Part of`, not a closing line

The enumeration pin for the fourteen now reads 0. The card stays open because the seat's amendment `5860244997` (Q2) keeps the 115-number remainder of the family on it, to be carried by later PRs after this one lands (see **Acceptance notes**).

## Premise, re-measured

- REST `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/N` and `/pulls/N`: all fourteen (#5489, #5498, #5853, #6938, #6939, #6950, #7070, #7071, #7628, #7632, #7635, #7688, #9318, #9473) answer 404 on both. Lit controls: objectui#10533 and objectui#7714 answer 200.
- The same fourteen in objectstack all answer 200. Thirteen are unrelated subjects. objectstack#6938 IS the `bodyShape` forwarding subject, and the seven in-scope lines that name it already spell `objectstack#6938`: live citations, which the card's instrument counted because its bare `#` branch matches inside `objectstack#6938`. They are untouched. No objectui site here is a mis-attributed objectstack number, so no site is re-qualified.
- Pending means pending: no `CHANGELOG.md` names any of the fourteen (42 changelogs; control: `packages/core/CHANGELOG.md` carries 140 `objectui#` mentions), so all 47 changesets edited here are pending.
- Base: `195052fff` (origin/main at dispatch; it carries the four PRs the deferral waited on). The census there reads the card's own numbers, below.

## Census (the enumeration pin)

The pin is this re-count, as PR objectui#10797 recorded its own. The instrument, reproducible as printed (REF = a commit):

```
git grep -nE '(objectui#|#|issues/)(5489|5498|5853|6938|6939|6950|7070|7071|7628|7632|7635|7688|9318|9473)([^0-9]|$)' REF -- '.changeset/*.md' 'packages/*/src/**' ':!**/__tests__/**' ':!**/*.test.*' ':!**/*.spec.*' ':!**/test/**' ':!**/tests/**' | grep -v 'objectstack#' | wc -l
```

- REF = `195052fff`: **224** lines, 66 changeset lines in 47 files and 158 src-nontest lines in 48 files.
- REF = `4906c4408` (this head): **0** lines. Round 1's head `6c3ad7c80` read 11, every one a `.describe(` line; patch round 1 (`19da7f8c0`) took them, and it read 0.
- This head merged with `main` at `4aebea00a` (`git merge-tree`, clean): 0.
- Lit control, the same printed instrument over live objectui#7714 at this head: 17 lines (20 without the `grep -v 'objectstack#'` filter, because three of those lines also name an `objectstack#` number). Hex-colour false positives (the pattern followed by a hex letter): 0.
- The card's own instrument (no `objectstack#` filter) reads 67 changeset lines in 48 files and 164 src-nontest lines in 54 files at the base, the card's figures exactly; the extra 1 and 6 are the `objectstack#6938` lines. At this head it reads 1 and 6: those 7, all live.
- Out of scope, as it stands (card's instrument, unchanged by this PR): 223 test lines in 80 files, 6 scripts lines in 2 files, 1 `.github` line, 0 governed, 6 other lines in 6 files.

## Citation form

- The 9-character backticked sha of the commit on `main` that landed the change the sentence rests on (the objectui#10707 / #10766 / #10797 form). Commits, not PRs: PR 7628, PR 7660 (the #7632 landing) and PR 5530 (the #5498 landing) answer 404 themselves. All 20 shas are ancestors of the base (`git merge-base --is-ancestor`, exit 0 each; control leg: the head of PR objectui#10851 answers exit 1) and `git rev-parse --short=9` returns the same 9 characters for each.
- A changeset's pointer to its OWN card is dropped, not replaced: `@changesets/changelog-git` prefixes each released entry with the hash of the commit that added the file, which is that landing.
- Where the sentence cites a RULING recorded on a dead card and no single commit is the ruling, the ruling is cited by its date, the form the same sentences already use: "the 2026-09-02 ruling" for the eight-group ruling on #6939, "the 2026-09-01 ruling (总监批 #28)" for the one on #7070.
- Inside a zod `.describe()` string the dead pointer is dropped, not replaced, in the PR objectui#10707 shape: a reader of a runtime description has no repository to resolve a sha against.
- Where the sentence says something was reported to a dead card, the live successor card that carried it is named (objectui#7561, objectui#7562).

## Special cases (the judgement calls)

1. **#7688.** "and objectui#7688 records the opposite" becomes "and the card that filed the `[floor-too-low]` finding recorded the opposite", and "The correction is recorded on objectui#7688." becomes "The correction is recorded in `639114c4d`, the commit that landed this entry." That commit's message carries the measured correction verbatim.
2. **`6939-filter-builder-mirror.md`.** "it is reported on objectui#6939 rather than decided here" and "it is reported on the same card" become the two live successors that carried them: objectui#7561 (the operator vocabulary fork and the blank trigger) and objectui#7562 (the seven refused field types). Both answer 200 and their titles match.
3. **"A control is restated, never deleted into a vacuum (objectui#7070)"** (two changesets, `plugin-chatbot/renderer.tsx`, `types/complex.ts`) cites `5f4514f7b`, whose message states that discipline for the control it retired ("re-expressed rather than deleted").
4. **`plugin-gantt/ObjectGantt.tsx`.** "the fabrication objectui#7070 spent this file's other branches removing" becomes "the fabrication the invented-binding work (`5f4514f7b`) spent this file's other branches removing". The claim is the original author's and is not re-judged here: `5f4514f7b` itself adds a test in that package, not a change to that file.
5. **`6150-undeclared-but-consumed-keys.md`.** Its sentence describes the `nodes` describe text ("records that a `nodes`-only document became legal ..."). The pointer becomes "(at `777e5c6f4`)", so the sentence stays true now that the patch round has taken the pointer out of that string too.
6. **`7070-no-invented-gantt-date-fields.md`.** "which objectui#7070 routes to a ruling rather than settling per-face" becomes "which is routed to a ruling rather than settled per-face": the changeset's own card, so the pointer is dropped and the sentence becomes passive.
7. **`8913-object-kanban-columns-declared.md`** and the `ObjectKanbanLaneSchema` docblock: "restores objectui#6939's finding / judging" becomes "restores what the kanban repair `240b80f31` established" / "the judging `240b80f31` established".
8. **`ObjectGanttSchema.data`'s description** (patch round) was "read FIRST by resolveRecordSourceConfig; undeclared on either face until objectui#6939". Dropping only the pointer would leave a dangling "until", and dropping "until" too would make the string say the key is undeclared, which is false. The clause goes with its pointer, leaving "Data source configuration — read FIRST by resolveRecordSourceConfig": the same shape as its `ObjectMapSchema.data` twin, which reads "Data source configuration — read FIRST by getDataConfig". It is the only one of the eleven where more than the pointer and its connective (" at", " (", ", ") left the string.
